Local integration changes to pptx-preview 1.0.7:
- Optional staticPreview mode skips playable audio/video decoding while retaining images.
- Per-presentation PreviewMediaResources owns media Blob URLs and releases them on replacement, failure and destroy.
- The original package media parts and renderer image behavior are retained.
See docs/editing-optimization.md in the source distribution for regression coverage.
